title: Teitoku no Ketsudan III with Power-Up Kit
native_title: 提督の決断Ⅲ ｗｉｔｈ パワーアップ・キット
overview:
Includes 7 fictional campaign scenarios! A super-dreadnought-class war simulation that lets you savor the thrill of alternate war history.

This World War II naval strategy game puts you in command of either the Imperial Japanese Navy or the United States Navy in the Pacific. Direct your fleets, plan your operations and fight for control of the ocean in a grand campaign of war at sea.

This edition is the Power-Up Kit version of Teitoku no Ketsudan III, adding the alternate-history campaign scenarios to the base game.

架空キャンペーンシナリオ7本を搭載！
戦史ifの醍醐味を味わえる超弩級ウォーSLG。
